newsitem.title: CHINA: Weifu Fuel H1 net hits 33 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Weifu Fuel H1 net hits 33 mln yuan.

text.p: China's Weifu Fuel Injection Co Ltd reaped net profits of 32.93 million yuan in the first half of 1997, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said on Friday.
Per-share net reached 0.18 yuan and turnover was 267.7 million yuan in the first six months, the exchange said in a notice issued after the markets closed.
It did not specify whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards and gave no comparative figures.
For the same period in 1996, the company posted net profits of 33.2 million yuan based on international standards.
Figure based on Chinese standards for the 1996 period were not immediately available.
